capabilities: autocomplete local filesystem paths inside backtick spans as they are typed
validate paths live and color valid ones green with invalid remainders red
insert a local path via a drill-down picker command
open or reveal the linked file or directory in the system file manager
resolve ~ and shell variables, optionally sourced from the login shell
extras: Desktop only (uses Node fs and Electron shell); the plugin states it never reads file contents or writes anything, only checks path existence and lists subfolders, and includes a detailed security section on avoiding command injection when expanding variables.
problem: Obsidian's own links work inside the vault, but there is no built-in way to link to files and folders elsewhere on your computer from inside a note.
summary: Turns backtick spans containing local filesystem paths into validated, clickable links that open or reveal the file, with autocomplete as you type.
